firmwareNotes: Silent original WebGL2 instrument. No audio or notes. Generate exactly one set action cc71 labelled Warp, range 0-127, step 1, curve linear, and three trigger actions pattern0/pattern1/pattern2 sending program change 0/1/2. Every action expects sense camera, effect any. Pattern names: Flow, Rings, Prism. Other CCs are documented for future bindings; keep the demo card to Warp and these three patterns.

sources.title: this repo: original visual synth implementation

usb.notes: Virtual MIDI-style output in the paired companion or simulated room; no USB permission required.

channels.receive: Channel 1. CC values 0-127. Program change 0-2 selects Flow, Rings, Prism. CC120/121/123 or panic resets all parameters and animation phase.

demo.visualFeedback: Camera compares the laptop screen's luma and colour before and after commands.
setup: Open /vsynth/ and keep the paired companion open, or use the sim laptop.
